movelist.name: Astonish
movelist.effect: Astonish Flinches the target on 15+. Once per scene, if the target is unaware of the user’s presence, Astonish automatically Flinches the target.

movelist.name: Payback
movelist.effect: If the target hit the user with a Damaging Move on the previous turn, Payback has a Damage Base of 10 (3d8+10 / 24) instead.

movelist.name: Gust
movelist.effect: If the target is airborne as a result of Fly or Sky Drop, Gust can hit them, ignoring Range and has a Damage Base of 8 instead.

movelist.name: Ominous Wind
movelist.effect: On 19+, the user has each of its stats raised by +1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Focus Energy
movelist.effect: The user becomes Pumped. While Pumped, the user’s Critical Range is extended by 2, or 18+ if the Critical Range is not otherwise extended. Being switched will cause this effect to end.

abilities.name: Unburden
abilities.effect: The default state of the user’s Speed is +2 Combat Stages. While holding a Held Item, the user’s Speed is lowered by 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Absorb Force
abilities.effect: The user takes damage as if the attack was resisted one step further.
